data.name: Hotel Safi Royal Luxury Valle
data.address: Av. Diego Rivera 555, Valle Oriente, 66260 San Pedro Garza García, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
Set in the suburb San Pedro Garza García, this posh neoclassical hotel with a modern glass-fronted tower is 5 km from Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Monterrey and 7 km from central Monterrey.
The refined rooms and suites have flat-screens and free Wi-Fi. Upgraded rooms add balconies, whirlpool tubs and/or city or Sierra Madre views. Airy suites offer separate living rooms with pull-out sofas. Room service is available 24/7.
There's a 24-hour buffet restaurant offering a rotating selection of international cuisines. Other amenities include a lobby bar, an exercise room and a business center, plus an outdoor pool with a waterslide and waterfall.
